input.quote: This Agreement and the performance of transactions under this Agreement shall be governed by the substantive laws of the state of New York.
input.rationale: Section 16.9 selects New York substantive law and requires any action to be commenced "in a court sited within the State of New York," which matches the preferred position (New York law, New York courts). No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned nothing), so there is no foreign arbitration seat or foreign exclusive venue risk. Minor points short of the preferred wording — venue is stated as the State of New York generally rather than exclusively New York County, and the clause is not expressly "exclusive" — are noted only, not deviations; the jury-trial waiver and the contractual limitations period are separate commercial terms outside this rule. No conflicting law/venue term appears in the general sections.
